title: Phantom Bomber
description: This mod spawns two bomb-dropping Phantoms every night at sunset. They attack players with timed TNT, making every night a survival challenge.
body:
# **PhantomBomber**
PhantomBomber is a survival mod that makes every night a dangerous challenge. As soon as the sun sets, two Phantoms appear to hunt you from the sky. They drop timed Mini-TNT, forcing you to keep moving while you build or explore.

With PhantomBomber, the night becomes a high-stakes survival mission.

### Main features:

**Nightly Attacks:** Phantoms spawn automatically at sunset to test your skills.

**Tactical Gameplay:** The Phantoms drop timed explosives, so you have to stay alert and keep moving.

**Fully Automatic:** The mod resets every morning and starts again the next night. No setup required.

**Server Friendly:** Install it on your server to add the challenge for all players. They don't need to install anything on their own computers. **_(Also works in singleplayer)_**

**Performance:** Very lightweight and does not slow down your game.

**_Installation:_** Built for Forge Loader, compatible with Minecraft 1.20.4. Just drop the file into your mods folder and survive the night!
